topics.title: Finding the House
topics.subtitle: Sat nav and the side road

blocks.content: Sat nav will get you to Wagtail Road. The house is down a small side road opposite number 12 — drive to the end to reach the property.
Google Maps works well for the last few metres.
Use the small road at the end of Wagtail Road. There is space to park while you unload.

topics.title: Spare Key and Lockbox
topics.subtitle: Secure spare key
topics.summary: Lockbox on the left of the house

blocks.caption: Key lockbox on the left-hand side of the house

blocks.content: A secure key lock box is on the left-hand side as you face the front. The access code is shared separately on arrival.
Return the spare key to the lock box before you leave.

blocks.heading: Before you go
steps: Lock the front door with the key (Yale-style lock — use the key).
Ensure patio doors are secured as needed.
Check Scooter is comfortable if she is staying in.

blocks.caption: EV charger and outdoor double socket at the front

blocks.content: An EV charger is at the front of the house. You're welcome to use it — please contact us beforehand so we can explain how it works.
There is also an outdoor double socket at the front if you need outdoor power.

items.label: Nearest stops
items.value: Around a 15-minute walk — No. 7 and No. 8 to Waterlooville and Portsmouth

blocks.content: Google Maps has live bus times. Uber is widely available; Vezu is a reliable local taxi firm.
She is full of energy, loves people, and will happily become your shadow. Sofas and beds are allowed.

blocks.heading: Each meal
steps: 1 scoop of dry food
¼ tub of wet food
Feed once in the morning and once in the evening

blocks.content: She may not eat straight away — leave food down and refresh at the next meal if anything is left.
No strict walk routine — whenever you fancy going out, she'll be delighted. Excellent recall off-lead in open spaces.

blocks.heading: Near roads
blocks.content: She is not very good near roads — use a lead for pavement walks.
She loves chasing a tennis ball; bringing it back is optional!

blocks.heading: Each morning
steps: Let Scooter out of the crate.
Let her into the back garden to do her business.

blocks.heading: Bedtime phrase
steps: Remove her collar before she goes into the crate (or take it off earlier in the evening).
Tell Scooter: "It's bedtime for dogs."
She usually heads to the back door for a last toilet break.
Then into her crate.
If she whines briefly, a calm "It's bedtime." usually settles her.

blocks.content: She nudges the bell hanging by the back door when she wants to go out. When ready to come back in, she presses the wireless dog doorbell outside.

topics.title: Grooming and Muddy Walks
topics.subtitle: After rolling in the wrong stuff

blocks.content: She sometimes rolls in deer or fox droppings — she needs a shower if that happens.
Dog shampoo is in the en-suite bathroom. Towel dry, then use the hairdryer. More common in wet winter weather; she dislikes rain.
Scooter can be left on her own for a few hours while you explore. She loves curling up on the sofa after a walk.
Happy, affectionate, people-friendly and pet-friendly. Can be nervous with new noises but settles quickly. Loves cuddles and blankets — morning bed cuddles welcome if you're happy for her to join.

topics.title: Hot and Cold Water Machine
topics.subtitle: No kettle — filtered instant hot and cold
topics.summary: Boiling and chilled water on tap

blocks.caption: Button layout on the water machine

blocks.content: There is no kettle — use this machine for tea, coffee and cooking water.

blocks.heading: Hot water
steps: Press the bottom-left button to heat the water.
When ready, press the red button above it for about one mug of boiling water.
If unused for a while, allow a minute or two to heat up.

blocks.heading: Cold filtered water
steps: Top blue button — one glass of chilled water.
Bottom blue button — about 750 ml (ideal for a jug).

blocks.heading: Important
blocks.content: The machine does not stop automatically when your cup or jug is full. Press any button to stop the flow before it overflows.
Use program 3 for best results. Tablets are under the sink.
The fridge by the washing machine off the kitchen is for your use, plus the top two freezer drawers. Please do not use the garage freezer or small fridge in the garage.
Tea, coffee, sugar and basics such as oil, herbs and spices are available — please help yourselves.
Feel free to use any appliance you need. Tumble dryer, vacuum and mop are in the garage (door from the lounge). Sandwich toaster and blender are under the air fryer cupboard.

topics.title: Washing Machine and Tumble Dryer
topics.subtitle: Laundry
topics.summary: Washer in kitchen, dryer in garage

blocks.content: Washing machine is in the kitchen. Tumble dryer is in the garage — access through the lounge.
Spare liners are under the kitchen sink.

blocks.caption: Wheelie bins down the side of the house

blocks.content: Collections are fortnightly on alternate weeks. If your stay includes collection day, wheel the right bin to the end of the small road the evening before.

blocks.heading: If Eco mode is showing
steps: Press the centre of the Nest thermostat.
Select the Heating icon (three horizontal lines).
Press the centre again to enable heating.

blocks.content: Outside scheduled times, turn the outer dial to your preferred temperature.
If you manually turn heating on after 10:30 pm, please set the thermostat back to 9°C before bed.
Outside these times the system heats more water automatically when needed.

blocks.heading: Location
blocks.content: Main stop tap under the kitchen sink — at the back of the cupboard.

blocks.caption: Consumer unit on the far wall of the garage

blocks.content: All circuits are clearly labelled.

blocks.heading: Downstairs and garage
blocks.content: "Alexa, turn downstairs on." / off — same for garage lights.

blocks.heading: Bedrooms
blocks.content: "Alexa, bedroom lights on." / off
At bedtime say "Alexa, bedtime." — turns off downstairs, garage and bedside lights and sets heating to 9°C overnight.

topics.title: Turning on the TV
topics.subtitle: LG remote on the sofa table

steps: Press the large red power button to turn the TV on and off.

blocks.caption: Source button below the navigation pad

blocks.heading: Apple TV (Input 3)
steps: Press the Source button (icon like a power cable beneath the four-way pad).
Select Input 3 – Apple TV.

blocks.content: Apple TV includes Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV+, BBC iPlayer, ITVX, Channel 4 and YouTube. Sign in with your own accounts if needed — sign out before you leave.
The lounge TV supports Apple AirPlay for streaming from your Apple devices.

steps: Connect to the house Wi-Fi.
Open the Sonos app — speakers should appear automatically.
Apple Music, Spotify, BBC Sounds and Global Player are available.

blocks.content: Try "Alexa, turn downstairs on/off", "Alexa, garage on/off", and "Alexa, bedroom lights on/off".

blocks.content: Say "Alexa, bedtime." This turns off downstairs, garage and bedside lights and sets heating to 9°C overnight.
Fresh towels are provided. Spare toilet rolls are in the downstairs toilet basket and in the top drawers of the storage unit.
Angle the shower head towards the shower door, not the back wall — it can leak if directed at the rear of the enclosure.
Upstairs family bathroom with a bath. Downstairs toilet also available.

The extractor fan runs with the bathroom light and continues briefly after the light is switched off.
Use outdoor seating, cushions, parasols and the dining area. Cushions may be left out in summer.
Indoor plants are artificial — no watering needed. If the weather has been dry for a few days, please water outdoor plants.
No hosepipe ban for Portsmouth Water users in Hampshire (Southern Water area may differ).
